'''Averon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] where he guarded a group of insane [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] until he was killed by an individual allied with the Sith Empire.<ref name="Freeing" />
